summaryZh: 中美洲考古实验室研究古代墨西哥与中美洲社会的政治和经济复杂性，尤其关注玛雅及其邻近文化。它结合遗址发掘、调查、器物分析、民族历史、图像学和铭文学开展研究。
researchQuestions: 古代墨西哥与中美洲的政治和经济复杂性如何出现？

evidence.quote: Our research focuses on the emergence of political and economic complexity among the ancient cultures of Mexico and Central America, particularly the Maya.
We study the ancient Maya and their neighbors through site excavation, survey, artifact analysis, ethnohistory, iconographic studies, and epigraphy.
Welcome to the Mesoamerican Archaeology Laboratory at UCSD.
